narrative.subMessage: Three different paths to lower HBM heat: iHBM, HPB + hybrid copper bonding, and circuit/base-die design.
narrative.headline: I-HBM Concept: Localized Hotspot Mitigation
narrative.summary: SK hynix proposes a dedicated heat path, Samsung uses copper spreading and bonding, and Micron refines the circuit and base die.
narrative.story: The source i-HBM concept shows heat leaving the hot D2D PHY area inside HBM. The table compares the three companies' technologies and key data in the same order as the source.
keyTakeaways: SK hynix iHBM: >30% reduction in thermal resistance
Samsung HPB + hybrid copper bonding: ~30% temperature reduction and 16% better thermal impedance
Micron circuit design + enhanced base die: >20% improvement in energy efficiency
